en: Go find him and ask about your schedule for the rest of the day.
He should be at Don Quijote.
Hello. It's very nice to meet you.
Thank you for coming. I hope you enjoyed it.
Thank you so much for coming today.
You're Haruka Sawamura-chan, aren't you?
I've been watching you on the Princess League. Wishing you the very best of luck!
I'll be rooting for you! You hear?
That's very kind of you. Thank you!
Nice work out there, Haruka. You're a real crowd pleaser.
Good for you. Bet you're feelin' a little more confident now, huh?
Yeah, a little.
Haruka, what happened up there?

You're not making use of your lessons at all! Surely you
coulda done better than that?
What am I gonna do with you...?

Oh, almost forgot. There's a meet and greet now, too. Better
get right to it.
Me? But I'm just a sub...

That's all right. Not like there's that many people here,
anyway. Don't worry about it.
Hey, nobody said bein' a pop star would be easy.
Hey, not bad. Not bad at all.

Okay. Well, there aren't many people here, and I don't
imagine it'll be easy to get 'em warmed up. But see what you
can do.
Try to gather more people with your singin'. Good luck.
All right. I will!
Good. Go get 'em, Haruka.
Haruka! Over here!
Good, you're here. Been waitin' for ya.
This is where I'm going to sing?

Most of the audience left once they heard the person they
came to see wasn't gonna make it.

She was supposed to perform and do a meet and greet,
apparently...

To be honest, it's a pretty crummy gig, but at least you'll
get a chance to practice performing on a stage.
Okay. Better get changed.
(Evening already...?)
Akiyama-san? This is Haruka.
Hey. Any news?

Horie-san should be back from the station by now... I've
been calling him, but he won't answer.
Hmm. Wonder if he ran into any trouble?

I wish I could get a hold of him. I'm thinking of going to
Dyna Chair to make sure he's all right.
...Okay, I'll go, too.

Oh, good. I didn't really want to go alone. Shall we meet at
the entrance to Dyna Chair?
Sure, sounds good.
Okay, see you soon.
(Well, that gives me some time... Maybe I'll get a little shut-eye until evening.)
(Nah. I guess not.)
(Time to hit the sack...)

All right. We're gonna let ya off easy this time, but
don't think we'll forget this!
Man... You mean I have to clean all this up?
Oh, good! You answered! Chief, I'm afraid I have bad news...
I just got a call from Horie-san at Dyna Chair.
The president, Park-san, committed suicide last night...
You're kidding.
He wants to talk about the money Park-san borrowed from us.
And I kinda went ahead and told him you were in town...
Yeah. That's fine.
I'll go see him right now. Talk to you later.

There you are, Chief! Where the heck were you!? I've been
trying to reach you all night!

Oh, Hana-chan. Yeah. Sorry about that. I lost track of time,
and, before I knew it, the sun was coming up.

Lost track of time? You were out drinking all night again,
weren't you!?

You said yesterday you'd be back in Tokyo by the end of the
day! I was up all night at the office waiting!
Oh. Sorry about that.
So? How's it going over there, anyway?
Oh, the new Sotenbori branch? Should be opening any day now!

I've got phones installed and a sign out front and
everything! No need to worry, Hana-chan. I'm on it.

I'm sure. After all, you've only been going to Osaka every
month for the last two years to get it ready...
I'm sure by now it's a modern marvel, a real sight to behold!
That sarcasm I'm hearing?

Chief, if you were really serious about opening that branch,
you'd have done it in less than a month.
Ah, sorry, Hana-chan. Somebody's at the door. I'll call you right back.

Somebody's at the door? Who would be visiting you this
early in the morning?
Beats me...

Oh, really? You're just trying to get rid of me! If you
think⑬
Sorry! Call you back! Bye, now!
Chief! Wait⑬
So ya finally decided to show up, eh, Sky Finance-han?

We stopped by about a million times, but you were always
out. Thought maybe you got cold feet or somethin'.

Well, I'm afraid we haven't had our grand opening yet, so
if you could just come back another time...

Didn't ya hear? If you're tryna start a business in our neck
of the woods, you gotta take it up with us first.
And you are...?
Omi Alliance. Name's Hakamada.
Omi Alliance...
Glad we got that straightened out.
Now, what can I do for you boys?

A little bird told me you lend any amount of money,
indefinitely, no interest charged.
So how's about loanin' us a trillion yen?
Ah, I get it. Well, I'm sorry to say you've wasted your time this morning.

I'm pretty busy right now, so I'm afraid I'll have to ask
you to leave.
Sorry. Did I keep you waiting long?

No, I just got here myself. I tried calling Horie-san again,
but still no answer...

Huh. Well, that's all right. Let's go see for ourselves if
the note's been returned yet.
Okay. You pass the test!
You learned <Color:9>Launch Strike<Color:Default>.
Looking at you reminds me of this one time...

I was looping through the air, dodging missiles and the like
when all of a sudden, I see this smokin' hot bikini babe on
the beach. Our eyes met, and she smiled at me.

But you were in a fighter plane, right? How could your eyes
have met?

Never you mind that. The point is: I'm really impressed by
your reflexes.

Why don't you come with me and make a name for yourself in
the Middle East?
Not in a million years, pal.
No? That's too bad.

Well, I'd better be on my way. Take care of yourself, you
hear?

Had enough for today, eh? Fine. We'll continue some other
time.
Wha⑬!? There's more!?

You think that's all I learned after staring down death
several times over in the scorching heat of the desert? Of
course there's more!

I'll be waiting here for you. Come back whenever you're
ready for more training.
What!? Look, don't wait here for my sake! Just go home!
I, uh... can't go home yet.
No way. Not yet!
All right, all right. No need to get worked up...
Akiyama-kun, I have to stay here... I have my reasons.

I hope you can understand and will come see me now and
again.
Saigo-san...
(What do I do? I have no idea what he's talking about.)

(It looks like he's pretty adamant about whatever it is he's
feeling, though.)
Okay. You got it. I'll stop by when I have a chance.

Wonderful! In the meantime, I'll be working 'round the clock
in preparation for your next visit!
Haha. Great...

Ahh, I feel like a new man! For a minute there, I wasn't
sure if I was going to make it!

I can't help but feel like I'm being taken for a ride here.
How much can you eat, anyway?

Well, I definitely appreciate it! And, hey. What's a little
food between old friends, right?
Yeah, sure... Now, I just have one tiny, little question.
A question? Wonderful! Lay it on me!
...Who are you?

Hahaha! You and your corny jokes! You couldn't make a
hyena laugh!

Well, I made you laugh, didn't I? But, seriously, who are
you?
Wait, are you serious? You really don't know who I am?
I'm serious. I don't know who you are.
All joking aside?
All joking aside.
I can't believe this. You're actually serious!

You're telling me you don't remember your senior officer!?
The man who taught you how to survive on the battlefield!?
Battlefield? What battlefield? Wait a sec!

That over-the-top commando schtick! You're Saigo-san! The
one I met in Kamurocho!
Oh, of all the ungrateful... Finally remembered, did ya!?

Ungrateful? Me? Well, I do recall that you taught me some
pretty useful stuff back there in Kamurocho.

But I also seem to remember that I forgave all of your bills
for my hostess club. So who's forgetful now?
Anyway, it's been a while, Akiyama-kun. How you been faring?

Oh, changing the subject, huh? I've been fine. Can't
complain.

What are you doing here? I thought you were giving shady
risk management lectures to young folks in Kamurocho.

What do you mean, "shady"!? Anyway, I let my students take
that over for me.

Despite my extensive experience on the battlefield, my time
in Kamurocho taught me that I still had some weaknesses.

So I decided to return to the life of a mercenary and hone
my skills.

Hone your skills...? This from the man I found facedown in
the street?
Hey, what were you doing there anyway?

It was all I could do to get to that spot from the airport.
I just ran out of resources and energy. That's all.
...Guess things are tough nowadays, huh? Even for mercenaries.

But I managed to make it these past three days on the street
thanks to my superb survival training.

Three days on the street!? You mean, you haven't bathed in
three days?

Of course I haven't! And I'd just returned from the
frontlines, so, actually, it's been more like ten days.

That's disgusting! I thought something smelled funny. That
was you!?

Quit actin' like a spoiled baby! There isn't enough water on
the battlefield to drink, let alone bathe!

But there's plenty of water at the airport. Or a hotel, for
that matter. Your hair's looking kind of crusty there.
Huh? I thought you used to shave your head.
On this last trip to the battlefield, I decided to try my hand at aerial combat.
Oh, okay. Sorry for asking about your hair.

And I came up with a new technique! I'd like to teach it
to you as a way of saying thanks for the meal!
Oh, there's no need for that. I'm pretty busy, actually.

I won't allow retreat! The orders of your senior officer are
absolute!
...Is this because I asked about your hair?
All right, fine. Let's see it.
That's the spirit! Prepare for battle!

Uh, let me just make sure. This is for training purposes,
right? I get this feeling you just want to beat me up...
Enough talk! We fight!
Hey, is that guy all right?
Maybe somebody should call an ambulance.
(Hm? What's going on here?)
Whoa, man down! You all right, pal!?
I know that voice... Akiyama-kun?
Yikes! How does he know my name?

Hah... Looks like I've been volunteered to take care of this
guy.
Guess I'll start by trying to get some food in him...
(It's already nighttime...)
Haruka-chan? It's Akiyama.

Horie-chan should be back from the station by now, but I
can't seem to get a hold of him.
Do you think he's in trouble?

I don't know. I think I'll go to Dyna Chair and see what's
going on.
I want to go, too.
Yeah? Okay, let's meet at the entrance to Dyna Chair, then.
See you soon.
Oh, look! Here it is.
So this is the infamous note?

Now, if we could just find some of her left-handed writing
to compare it to. See anything?

Come to think of it, she wrote Horie-san a memo just before
she died, and she used her left hand.
I bet it's still around here somewhere.
Hey, how about that safe?
...It's locked.
You're going to open it?
What an oddly-shaped keyhole.
See for yourself. It looks like you could shove a pencil or something in there.
Nope, no good. Not that I expected it to work.
Wait a minute. Maybe...

A pen Park-san gave to me before she died. She said it was
an early debut present...
Hmm... It doesn't look like Horie-chan's back yet.
No, it doesn't...
Where do you think Park-san's note might be?
In Park-san's office, if the police have returned it.
They've been putting her things in a tray there.
Mind if we exchange email addresses?
Oh, of course.

Heh. Don't think I've ever gotten an idol's email address
before. Must be pretty lucky.
Okay, well, I guess I'll head back to my office.

Well, I can't just wait around here, so I think I'll go down
to the police station. Maybe that'll speed up us getting the
evidence back.

I'll probably be back this evenin' at the earliest. You can
use this time to do whatever ya need.
All right. Thank you, Horie-san.
Oh, no need to thank me. This is for Dyna Chair's future.

(Horie-san will be back this evening. Maybe I should go home
and try and get some rest.)

Sorry to spring this on you, but it looks like Haruka-chan
will be coming with me.
The two of us are going to look into whether or not it was really suicide.
What!? Why Haruka-chan!?
Well, to tell the truth, this isn't the first time Haruka and I have crossed paths.

I never dreamed she was here at Park-san's agency. I could
barely believe my eyes when I saw her.

I see. Small world. And, well, with what's happened and
all...
I guess this is no time for her to be thinkin' about the Princess League, anyway.
The Princess League?

Oh, yeah. It's an audition-style music competition put on by
an Osaka TV station.
